title: The Last Toast at Briar Hall
premise: Lord Edmund Voss gathered his household at Briar Hall to announce a new will.
At 9:00 PM he raised a glass of his own vintage port, drank, and collapsed. He was dead before the doctor reached him.
Nobody has left the hall. One of you poisoned him.
rules: Share, hide or lie about anything on your sheet. Only your secret goal must stay hidden.
Props change hands only when the holder hands them over.
At the end everyone votes in secret for the killer.

victim.name: Lord Edmund Voss
victim.text: The victim. Owner of Briar Hall, about to change his will.

run_of_show: Start Round 2, open the Butler's Room envelope (15 min)
Open voting, reveal, then secret goals (10 min)
